about: Read-only questions about this repository, modelled on real past asks. Each runs against a snapshot at `pin`, so the answers stay fixed while the agent code under test changes. `expect` patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions that must all match the final answer.

tasks.prompt: Read-only question, no edits: does the daemon compact a session's conversation automatically? Say yes or no, name the HTTP route that starts compaction, and say how many of the most recent turns it keeps verbatim.
Read-only question, no edits: which tool does the coding agent use to search file contents? Give its default and maximum number of matching lines, and the external program it prefers when available.
Read-only question, no edits: in the daemon, what exact result text does a tool call receive when its turn's permission mode is deny and the call is not preapproved? Name the file where this happens.
Read-only question, no edits: how long does the daemon reuse a cached Drive Next queue for a workspace, and what makes it ask the model again before then?
Read-only question, no edits: which daemon HTTP route switches the active model, and which request fields does it accept for the model and its thinking level?

Read-only question, no edits: what prompt cache key does the daemon send to the provider for a main turn, and what does a sub-agent use instead? Name the provider file that writes prompt_cache_key into the request.

Read-only question, no edits: does a sub-agent see the parent conversation's history? Describe which messages a sub-agent starts with, and what it is told when its tool budget is spent. Name the file.
Read-only question, no edits: where does Agent Drive keep project memory on disk, in what file format, and how is an entry forgotten without rewriting earlier lines?
